limits: All primary cases must win the complete three-study journey. Deliberate terminal losses and recoverable failed attempts are separate edge coverage, never substitutes for wins.

Most winning fixtures are author source-informed geometric/control searches replayed through public UI. Step and Spring and Common Meadow fixtures derive from independent ordinary visible-rule play and identify their provenance in motion-plans.json. Replaying these fixtures is not new independent discovery.

Desktop uses native Enter on named controls and pointer activation of public grid cells where recorded. Mobile uses only touchscreen taps on controls and visible grid cells. No state mutation, hidden answers or runtime hooks are used.
Touch is Chromium or WebKit emulation at390px, not a physical phone;320px layout and control keyboard alternatives checked. No actual screen reader certification.
Structural and physical systems use explicitly documented simplified deterministic models; these tests establish their game behavior, not engineering prediction accuracy.
